feeds.description: Fillmore Container has been supplying glass bottles and jars to the food and beverage industry for over 20 years. Whether you're learning to preserve for the first time, or bottling a truckload of your grandma's sauce recipe for Whole Foods. Our blog covers every aspect of canning and preserving, including equipment, techniques, and proper food safety.

feeds.description: The culinary adventures of Lindsay and Taylor. We're not chefs, in fact we've had our fair share of flames and failures. But like any good relationship, cooking has its ups and downs. We're all about quick and flavorful dishes that don't hurt the wallet. We invite you to our kitchen (as tiny as it may be) and share in our love for food and our desire to always find something new to eat.
